title: Systematic multi-omic deconvolution of the clinical heterogeneity of Down syndrome

evidence_spans.quote: Here we report a multi-omic investigation of 100 clinical phenotypes
Persons with Down syndrome, the genetic condition caused by trisomy 21

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a primary human clinical multi-omic study, but it analyzes Down syndrome and co-occurring conditions rather than an aging construct; multi-omics is therefore not assessed.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Clinical phenotypes/co-occurring conditions in persons with Down syndrome, including obesity and congenital heart defects
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Multi-omic signatures, including proteomic, metabolomic, transcriptomic, and immune changes
